summary: requires global constants R and θ under `<Constants>` and a `<Solutes>` entry. Nodal variables are effective fluid pressure p̃ and effective solute concentration c̃. Multiple solutes may be defined.
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.15.2 General Specification of Biphasic-Solute Materials, p345（4.13）

phi0.meaning: solid volume fraction φs_r in the reference configuration

permeability.meaning: specification of the hydraulic permeability k (§4.14.2)

osmotic_coefficient.meaning: specification of the osmotic coefficient Φ (§4.15.5)

solute.meaning: specification of the solute properties (required `sol` attribute referencing a solute id in `<Globals><Solutes>`)

diffusivity.meaning: (child of `solute`) specification of the solute diffusivities d and d0 (§4.15.3)
diffusivity.note: 手册列出该参数，但 pyfebio 当前版本没有对应字段，建模时无法传入。

solubility.meaning: (child of `solute`) specification of the solute effective solubility κ̃ (§4.15.4)
solubility.note: 手册列出该参数，但 pyfebio 当前版本没有对应字段，建模时无法传入。

example.source: pyfebio 0.3.0 默认值，已通过构造验证；数值为占位默认，建模前请按实际工况替换。
